step.action: Skill scans the host project and writes core/project.config.json

step.output:
✅ **Project Analysis Complete**
Display the following detected properties: - Frontend framework and version - Backend framework and base URL - Database engine - Auth scheme - Detected routes (pages and API endpoints count) - Package manager
Full config saved to: AI-QA-FRAMEWORK/core/project.config.json

step.goal: Self-review — verify artifact completeness and accuracy

artifact-checklist.file: Project config — must exist and be valid JSON

quality-checklist.check: project.config.json exists and is parseable JSON — FAIL if missing or malformed
frontend field is a real framework name (Angular/React/Vue/Blazor etc.), NOT null or "unknown"
backend.framework is populated and backend.baseUrl is a real URL, NOT a placeholder
database field is populated — if no DB found, explicitly state "none" (not blank)
auth.scheme is one of: jwt / oauth / session / basic / none — NOT blank
routes.pages contains at least one real route entry
No field contains "unknown", "detected", "N/A" or is left empty

review.fix-if-needed: For every failed check, apply the specific fix before marking this step complete: - PC-2 fails → re-scan package.json dependencies and src/ entry files; update frontend field - PC-3 fails → ask user: "What is your backend base URL (e.g. http://localhost:3000)?" then update config - PC-6 fails → read router config files (app-routing.module.ts, routes.js, etc.) and extract routes; update config - Any other blank/unknown field → ask user to confirm the correct value then update project.config.json After all fixes re-display the corrected configuration summary and confirm all checks pass.

step.output: ✅ Review complete — project.config.json is verified and accurate
